categories.evidence: Touches ci/test/03_test_script.sh to adjust how compile_commands.json is prepared for the IWYU CI script.
categories.rationale: Filters excluded subtree files from the compilation database to reduce noise and redundant processing in non-enforced CI. As noted in the description, 'Every run prints IWYU suggestions for 14 libmultiprocess files in the non-enforced pass, applies them, and then reverts them', offering minor speedup and log cleanliness with no impact on core CI reliability or release integrity.
